text:
harper: Running the sample Cloudflare Worker with the TS SDK and hitting import/runtime + typing weirdness.
joel: Error text? ESM vs CJS?
harper: Runtime: "SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module". Editor shows client.generate(...) as `any` unless I force a generic at the call site.
anya: Classic exports map + tsconfig mismatch. Which path are you importing?
harper: `import { createClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` (no subpath).
joel: If bundler resolves the package require path you get CJS in an ESM-only runtime (workers). Add an explicit ESM export or a worker entry.
anya: TS side: if d.ts has multiple overloads where one returns `any` or `unknown`, inference collapses. We should prefer a single generic signature `generate<T = JsonValue>(opts): Promise<T>`.
harper: My tsconfig: module=ESNext, moduleResolution=node, target=ES2020.
joel: Switch moduleResolution to "bundler" (or node16 for node-targeted builds). For Wrangler + esbuild, "bundler" is the safer choice.
anya: Short-term workaround: `const res = await client.generate<MyShape>(...)`. Longer term: change the public d.ts default generic away from `unknown` and reduce overlapping overloads.
devops-bot: CI: edge-worker smoke failed earlier — creating issue and assigning to eng-runtime.
joel: We should publish a worker-specific entrypoint and add "./worker": { "import": "./dist/esm/worker-entry.mjs" } to exports. That prevents ambiguous resolution in many bundlers.
aha: (typo) — an update — I switched moduleResolution to bundler and added a ./worker export locally; runtime error fixed and types are better. Still had to annotate one call to get full shape.
anya: That suggests default generic still too wide. Propose default = `JsonValue` and single export type: `generate<T = JsonValue>(opts: GenerateOpts): Promise<T>`.
joel: Also add `typesVersions` for older TS toolchains and an extra compat.d.ts for deep node resolution weirdness. Add a CI test that builds the package with esbuild targeting workers to catch regressions.
harper: I'll open PRs: (1) worker export, (2) typings cleanup, (3) sample-app README note + tsconfig snippet.
ci-bot: Linked issues created: #811 #812 #813.
anya: Quick README snippet for onboarding: "If you see import errors in Edge Workers: ensure package.json exports include an ESM worker path and set tsconfig.moduleResolution to "bundler". If types widen to `any`, annotate the call or upgrade to the patched SDK."
joel: Thanks — that should prevent a bunch of workshop breakages.
harper: Confirmed, demo unblocked. :rocket:
